description: Judge seat of the review pipeline (#1222 Phase B): investigates one probe-raised flag against the code it was raised on and rules confirmed, needs_check, or false_positive. Every confirmed flag is re-judged a second time (fresh call, same prompt) before it reaches the author — disagreement between the two passes demotes the flag to needs_check rather than shipping a coin-flip as a defect report. Deliberately tool-less (the record handed in the prompt is everything the judge weighs) and deliberately no output_schema (the contract is reason-freely-then-one-fenced-JSON-block, so reasoning-capable models keep their reasoning room). Review-path note (#1550 cluster item 4): this role dispatches through the review pipeline's `ChatCall` primitive (model/system/user/temperature/max_tokens/endpoint only), not `dispatch_internal`/`DispatchOpts` — only the sibling `.md` persona is actually read on this path. `tool_palette`/`output_schema`/`bail_after_compactions`/`feedback_templates` below describe the role's intent for a human reader; they are NOT enforced or consumed by a review run.
